specific_objectives: 17.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to understand the development of composite materials, types and functions of fibers and resin, Defects in composite, selection criteria for Matrix, fabric weaves, prepress, strength flowcharts

practical: Review of stress-strain diagrams for metal and composite materials; Instructor supervision required for diagram interpretation.
intro_questions: What is the primary difference between isotropic and anisotropic materials?
Define the elastic limit in the context of metal stress-strain curves.
List two common defects found in composite materials.
